name: Lint Belve
source:
The Somnolent Darling

Prince of Akedia. Forever sleepy and loath to put forth effort, his considerable magical power has put his kingdom's expectations squarely on his shoulders. You may be the source of inspiration he has been looking for...

Indulgence: Anything easy to ingest, as he can't be bothered to eat.
Pastime: Sleeping, relaxing

[From the English app "Court of Darkness"]
